newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DC Finance ups preference shares issue.
newsitem.headline: DC Finance ups preference shares issue.

text.p: DC Finance (Holdings) Ltd said it had increased the number of redeemable preference shares in a private placement to 30 million from 26 million.

The subscribers of the preference share will be entitled to receive one new 1999 warrant for every preference share held and 30 million new shares or 4.7 percent of the company's enlarged share capital will be issued upon full exercise of the warrants.
The company said each warrant would entitle holders to subscribe one company share at HK$5.50 each, compared with their closing price of HK$5.10 per share on Friday.
DC Finance said HK$300 million proceeds of the placing before expenses would be used for working capital.
